item.title: How can I find out about new channels on the mobile app?
item.description: Learn about new channels on the mobile app. Find out more here.

item.title: Can I favourite TV programmes?
item.description: You can’t set individual TV programmes as favourites, but you can mark your favourite channels. Find out more here.

item.title: Can I restart programmes that have already started?
item.description: Some, but not all, channel players let you restart live programmes. Find out more here.

item.title: How do I access subscription video on demand services on the Freesat mobile app?
item.description: How do I access subscription video on demand services on the Freesat mobile app? Find out more here.

item.title: How do I access the TV Guide?
item.description: You’ll find the TV Guide in the centre of the menu at the bottom of the Freesat mobile app, it’s labelled Guide. Find out more here.

item.title: How do I find and watch live and on demand TV on the Freesat mobile app?
item.description: When you open the Freesat mobile app, as long as you're online, you'll instantly see what’s on TV at that moment. Find out more here.

item.title: Freesat Update
item.description: A brand-new update has been released for Freesat customers with a Freesat Recordable 4K TV Box or a Freesat 4K TV Box. Find out more here.

item.title: Software update 16th September 2025
item.description: A new software update, v1.7.0, is now available and will be automatically installed on Freesat 4K TV boxes. Find out more here

item.title: How to reset your pin number
item.description: How to reset your Freesat pin number, find out more here.

item.title: Freesat Update
item.description: As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance your experience, we'll be introducing some platform improvements from 13 October 2025. These updates will apply to Freesat 4k Devices. Find out more here.
